description: Advances: specled.package. From the specled_-xde verifier (2026-07-26, epic specled_-0x4): skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/adoption-phases.md:38 states the phase criterion 'mix spec.check exits 0 with no findings beyond detector_unavailable'. Applying that criterion requires seeing info-level findings, which bare mix spec.check hides — the adopter sees only 'info hidden; --verbose to show'. It is a criterion rather than a probe instruction (weaker than the four N2 sites xde fixed) but the same trap. Add --verbose (or the SPECLED_SHOW_INFO=1 form) to that line, matching the style specled_-xde used at the four probe sites.

comments.text:
ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27)
Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98).

VERDICT: still_applicable   EFFORT: trivial
Mandate confirmed still applicable as written; no narrowing needed.

== SCOPED REMAINING WORK ==
Full mandate remains; one-line edit plus gate co-change.

1. skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/adoption-phases.md:38 — change
   `- \`mix spec.check\` exits 0 with no findings beyond \`detector_unavailable\``
   to the --verbose form, matching the style already used at SKILL.md:124/:465 and detection-matrix.md:83/:237, e.g.
   `- \`mix spec.check --verbose\` exits 0 with no findings beyond \`detector_unavailable\` (info-level findings are hidden without \`--verbose\`; \`SPECLED_SHOW_INFO=1\` is equivalent)`
   Keep `detector_unavailable` spelled exactly as-is (it is an author-enforced bare snake_case code — test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs does NOT guard it, per .spec/specs/package.spec.md:113 — so a typo will not be caught mechanically).

2. Satisfy the file-touch branch guard for subject `specled.package`. adoption-phases.md matches the surface glob at .spec/specs/package.spec.md:53, and `branch_guard_missing_subject_update` is `:error`. Either (a) extend the current-truth sentence at .spec/specs/package.spec.md:25-29 (append-only prose; the existing clause "using `--verbose` when instructing adopters to probe for info-level `detector_unavailable` findings on stdout" can be widened to cover phase done-criteria, not just probe instructions), or (b) land a `Spec-Drift:` trailer with a one-line reason on the commit. If the bundled PR already edits package.spec.md for another ticket, option (a) is free.

3. Verify with `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` (expect `spec.check result=pass`). Do not run the bare form.

NOT in this ticket's mandate, but flag to the orchestrator as the same untreated defect class (do NOT silently fold in without a scope decision):
- skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/task-templates.md:45 — "`mix spec.check` exits 0 with at most `detector_unavailable` findings" is the phase0 task-template mirror of the exact line z5t fixes; it will read inconsistently once :38 changes. task-templates.md was owned by specled_-0x4.4 in the prior epic.
- docs/adoption.md:519-520 — "run `mix spec.check` once and look for a `detector_unavailable` finding whose reason is `umbrella_unsupported`" is a genuine PROBE instruction (stronger case than z5t's criterion) still missing `--verbose`; xde declared docs/adoption.md out of scope as "already swept by specled_-zhe", but the sweep did not add the flag here.

== EXPECTED TOUCHES ==
skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/adoption-phases.md, .spec/specs/package.spec.md

== RISK NOTES ==
REALIZATION HASHES: no risk. .spec/realization_hashes.json has exactly one top-level key, "api_boundary", and holds module/function bindings only — a markdown edit under skills/ cannot move any hash. No `--accept-drift` needed.

SPEC REQUIREMENT IDS: z5t does not need to edit any `spec-requirements` statement. Its only spec touch is the free-prose current-truth block at .spec/specs/package.spec.md:25-39, and only if option (a) is chosen for the co-change. That prose block is the collision surface.

CONFLICT DETAIL (same file+region, since all 22 land as ONE PR):
- specled_-4pl (Advances: specled.package) — targets .spec/decisions/specled.decision.doc_identifier_lint_spec_corpus.md and test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs. Its ADR edit is likely to force its own package.spec.md co-change, and its FINDING-1 rewording touches the same requirement family as package.spec.md:113. Region overlap is package.spec.md, not adoption-phases.md.
- specled_-ozm (Advances: specled.package) — edits test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs @allow_marker_pattern / @allow_marker_comment_pattern; same file as 4pl's finding 2 (4pl and ozm conflict with each other harder than with z5t). Possible package.spec.md:113 statement co-change.
- specled_-yds (Advances: specled.package) — edits test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs; may co-change package.spec.md concepts_guide requirement.
No other ticket in the set touches skills/spec-led-bootstrap/** — adoption-phases.md:38 itself is uncontested. Verified by reading all 21 sibling ticket bodies.

ORDERING: no hard dependency. z5t can land in any order. If it lands AFTER a package.spec.md-editing sibling, reconcile the current-truth prose additively (the block is append-only-checked: `append_only/requirement_deleted` and `append_only/must_downgraded` are :error at lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex:26-27 — never rewrite an existing requirement statement to make room).

GATE FLAKINESS: none introduced. This ticket adds no tests and flips no verification stubs, so the known timing-flaky `tagged_tests` leg is not newly exercised. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` is sufficient proof for the docs edit; the branch guard needs a valid `--base` (default origin/main) to evaluate the co-change leg — a run with `--base HEAD` will show zero changed files and prove nothing.

SILENT-FAILURE HAZARD SPECIFIC TO THIS TICKET: `detector_unavailable` is explicitly excluded from the machine-guarded code families (.spec/specs/package.spec.md:113 lists it as an author-enforced bare snake_case identifier). test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs will stay green on a misspelling. Reviewer must eyeball the token.

SCOPE CONTRACT (orchestrator, specled_-k6s — 2026-07-27)

Authoritative for mechanical scope checks. Supplements, does not replace, the
ADMISSION VERIFICATION comment's mandate (items 1-3), which is what you implement.

## Allowed touches
- `skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/adoption-phases.md` — the phase0
  done-criterion line only.
- `.spec/specs/package.spec.md` — spec co-change is AUTHORIZED, and takes
  precedence over Out of Scope, to clear the `branch_guard_missing_subject_update`
  file-touch finding for subject `specled.package`. Prefer option (b), a
  `Spec-Drift:` commit trailer. If you choose option (a) instead, the
  current-truth prose block is APPEND-ONLY: never rewrite or delete an existing
  requirement statement to make room (`append_only/requirement_deleted` and
  `append_only/must_downgraded` are both `:error`).

## Out of Scope (files)
- `skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/task-templates.md` — the phase0 mirror of
  this same line. The admission pass flagged it as the SAME untreated defect
  class but explicitly outside this mandate. Do NOT silently fold it in. If you
  believe it must change, say so in your completion record and let the
  orchestrator carve it.
- `docs/adoption.md` — same reason; explicitly deferred.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (orchestrator consolidates once at the end), `VERSION`,
  `.spec/realization_hashes.json`, `.spec/state.json`.
- Every file not listed under Allowed touches.

## Out of Scope (intent)
- No code, no tests, no new dependencies.
- Keep `detector_unavailable` spelled EXACTLY as-is. It is an author-enforced
  bare snake_case code that `test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs` does NOT guard,
  so a typo ships silently. Eyeball the token before committing.
- Do not weaken spec prose or add a false `decisions:` link to quiet branch-guard.

## Verification (change-scoped, run-until-green; host mix, no compose)
1. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` — expect `spec.check result=pass`.
   The branch guard needs a real `--base` to evaluate the co-change leg; a run
   with `--base HEAD` sees zero changed files and proves nothing.
2. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`

Do NOT run bare `mix spec.check` and do NOT run the full suite. The orchestrator
owns whole-system proof at the merge gate and PR CI.
